results.caption:
👇🏼 the truth about working with *big* brands 

btw followers are up by 7k now since I finished editing this video 🫪

For UGC creators specifically, it’s very rare that you’re going to land a deal like this through direct pitching

It doesn’t matter if you have 4 Toyotas at home
It doesn’t matter if you’re a car mechanic
It doesn’t matter if you’ve worked at a Toyota dealership for +13 years

Unless your personal branding content is so hyper specifically geared towards the niche you’re trying to attract (which if you did, you’d be considered an influencer rather than a UGC creator)

The *actual* way to attract big brands like this is not going to be through any traditional methods you might be having in mind

Before Toyota, I wasn’t posting ANY car content.

I was just showing the results of as many creative projects I was doing for other brands as I could

And somehow got lucky enough that the agency running Toyota’s campaigns happened to come across my other content and thought it was creative enough for Toyota!

The true way to attract more corporate brands is by showing your creative projects and showing brands that you can do product placement I more creative ways than just “This is the product I’ve been using and this is why I love it” - its way too on the nose and corporate brands don’t really need that

And even if you do that / have been doing that, unicorn deals like the one I got with Toyota are not guaranteed either! 

That’s the thing with personal branding - the opportunities you get will always be a coin flip but the fact that you do get unexpected opportunities coming your way is enough of a reason to be consistent with your content

Hope this gives some of you guys more context on expectations!!
